locationFaqs: What happens on the free discovery call?
We talk about your business, your current challenges and the support you need. It’s an opportunity to ask questions and understand how we could help, with no obligation.
Which motor trade businesses do you support?
Independent dealers, small dealer groups, garages, workshops, body shops and specialist businesses, from start-ups to businesses turning over around £15 million.
Can you work with our existing bookkeeper?
Yes. We can work alongside your existing team, filling gaps and providing specialist support where it’s needed.
Can you review our current tax and accounts?
Yes. A business health check can identify issues in your systems, accounts and tax position. Any recommendations depend on your individual circumstances.
Do I need to visit your Norwich office?
No. Although we are based in Hethersett, Norwich, our service is fully remote. We work with you by phone, video call and cloud accounting software, without office appointments or client visits.
Can you take over from my current Norwich accountant mid-year?
We can discuss a mid-year switch and help plan a practical handover. The timing depends on your records, upcoming deadlines and existing arrangements.
marginFaqs: Which cars qualify for the margin scheme?

Eligible second-hand vehicles can qualify when the purchase and record-keeping conditions are met. New vehicles, separately VAT-invoiced purchases and most imports are excluded. Special cases, including Northern Ireland and collectors’ vehicles, need separate consideration.
Can I use it on a car bought from a VAT-registered dealer?

The purchase invoice and the transaction both matter. A car bought on an invoice showing VAT separately cannot be sold under the margin scheme, even if you did not reclaim that VAT. Where a dealer sells under the margin scheme, the invoice should carry the appropriate margin scheme wording; the other eligibility conditions still apply.

Keep your usual VAT records, a stock book tracking each vehicle and purchase and sales invoices. Include the vehicle registration number, or VIN where there is no registration, and make/model. Margin scheme invoices must meet the relevant requirements, including the scheme wording on sales invoices without VAT shown separately.

The agreed part-exchange value forms part of the selling price of the car you supply. That same value becomes the purchase price of the vehicle taken in part-exchange. Check the incoming vehicle is eligible and record it properly.
Can you review past VAT returns and help correct mistakes?

We can discuss a review of past returns and the records behind them. If errors are identified, we can help establish the appropriate correction process. An error may mean an overpayment or an underpayment; a refund is not guaranteed.
Do you work with dealers outside Norfolk?
Yes. We support independent dealers across the UK remotely, using phone, video calls and cloud accounting software. You do not need to visit an office.
